title: Sample questions and sample answers
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to demonstrate understanding of information that is implied but not directly stated.
Students will be able to identify connections between ideas, opinions, and attitudes across multiple texts.
Students will be able to deduce the meaning of unfamiliar words or phrases by reading the surrounding information
Students will be able to compare a set of questions against one continuous text divided into sections or up to five shorter related texts.
Students will be able to select the specific text section that contains the relevant information or idea to answer a prompt.
Students will be able to analyze questions for key action verbs and thematic keywords.
Students will be able to recognize paraphrased information and corresponding synonyms within a text.
Students will be able to evaluate subtle shifts in a writer's motivation, attitude, or personal feelings.
